The song is also accompanied by a video that features footage of the Prince of Wales and his wife in action, as well as footage of the Invictus Games in The Hague. items.hyp: 'sokwana boom' 'sokwana boom' is a phrase that translates to "The drums boomed" in Setswana. The phrase is used to describe the sound of drums being played in a specific location. In this case, the location is a south-eastern Spanish town with 3,700 inhabitants. The phrase is used to convey the excitement and energy of the event, as well as to emphasize the importance of social distancing in the event.
